lines.text: Via delle Fornaci 7 · Borgo Valdorso (TO) · Production plant
Quality note QN-2018-009 - foreign matter retained by screen VS-1
Three times in May-June 2018 the 1 mm screen retained fragments of PE big-bag liner
(up to 4 cm) torn when the bag outlet was cut.
Without the screen these fragments would have reached the disperser and the filling line
Action: keep the 1 mm screen as a foreign-matter barrier for big-bag deliveries.
Operators re-instructed on opening the bag outlet.
